style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">It is possible to generate automatically a SHACL specification from the analysis of an RDF knowledge Such a specification can serve to bootstrap a Sparnatural configuration adjusted by hand, </span><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">or can be fed directly to Sparnatural, since Sparnatural has default behaviours that allows it to work with a plain SHACL file (without Sparnatural-specific annotation) – of course, in that case, features like icons or ordering of entities will be missing.</span></p><p style="line-height:114%;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;border:none;mso-border-left-alt:none;mso-border-top-alt:none;mso-border-right-alt:none;mso-border-bottom-alt:none;mso-border-between:none">&nbsp;</p><p style="line-height:114%;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;border:none;mso-border-left-alt:none;mso-border-top-alt:none;mso-border-right-alt:none;mso-border-bottom-alt:none;mso-border-between:none"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">Sparna maintains SHACL Play! At </span><a href="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr" title="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#0000ff;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#0000ff"><u>https://shacl-play.sparna.fr</u></span></a><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000"> . This tool</span><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">, amongst other features,</span><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000"> allows to generate a SHACL specification profile from the analysis of an RDF Knowledge Graph. The </span><a href="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr/play/generate" title="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr/play/generate"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#0000ff;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#0000ff"><u>SHACL generation form</u></span></a><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000"> is freely available online but we suggest to run this kind of analysis using the </span><a href="https://github.com/sparna-git/shacl-play/wiki/Run-SHACL-Play-App-from-command-line#the-generate-command" title="https://github.com/sparna-git/shacl-play/wiki/Run-SHACL-Play-App-from-command-line#the-generate-command"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#0000ff;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#0000ff"><u>command-line tool</u></span></a><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">. The algorithm to derive the SHACL specification is </span><a href="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr/play/generate#documentation" title="https://shacl-play.sparna.fr/play/generate#documentation"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#0000ff;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#0000ff"><u>precisely documented</u></span></a><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">.</span></p><p style="line-height:114%;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;border:none;mso-border-left-alt:none;mso-border-top-alt:none;mso-border-right-alt:none;mso-border-bottom-alt:none;mso-border-between:none">&nbsp;</p><p style="line-height:114%;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;border:none;border-left:none;border-top:none;border-right:none;border-bottom:none;mso-border-between:none"><span style="font-family:'Arial';font-size:11pt;color:#000000;mso-style-textfill-fill-color:#000000">Sparnatural deployments such as </span><a href="https://www.nakala.fr/sparnatural/"
